messages:
maria (CS): Heads up: Hillcrest reporting p99 embed latency ~8-12s since 10:05 UTC, started after yesterday's model swap. Customer says >50% requests slow. Opening thread to coordinate. Hillcrest account: acct-8342. @sam @lena

sam (SRE): Looking now — p50 ~100ms but p99 spikes at 8s on embed-serving-prod, tenant tag hillcrest. Correlates with heavy batch sizes from their nightly job. Pulling logs and shard metrics.

ops-bot: Alert: embed-latency > 5s for tenant hillcrest on node gpu-13, 120 occurrences in last 10m.

lena (ENG-PLATFORM): I see a pattern: requests with batch_key=bulk-embed-qa are not being split, so big batches sit in the router queue. Routing rules accidentally map that key to low-priority PS pool after the model swap. Could be a config mismatch between routing table and split rules.

sam (SRE): Can you paste the recent router logs? Quick mitigation option: enforce a per-tenant concurrency cap (2) and put hillcrest on priority-lane for 30m to drain backlog. I can also create a short reservation. That should lower p99 without an immediate code rollback.

maria (CS): Customer prefers not to be throttled, but they're ok with a short maintenance window. They specifically asked if we can do an allowlist/reservation so their SLAs aren't hit.

sam (SRE): Creating ephemeral reservation now: `/deploy reservation create --tenant hillcrest --pool p2-priority --duration 2h` — running. Will also set concurrency cap for that tenant to 2 while we monitor.

ops-bot: Command accepted. Reservation id res-2024-8342 created. Routing updated: hillcrest -> p2-priority (ephemeral).

lena (ENG-PLATFORM): I'm applying a batch-splitting patch to the embed-router: `{"batch_split_threshold": 8}` — this forces any incoming batch >8 to be split into sub-batches. Pushing to canary now.

sam (SRE): After reservation and split, p99 dropped from ~8s to ~600ms in the last 5m. Queue depth on gpu-13 also down by 90%.

maria (CS): Customer confirmed the UI shows much faster responses and timeouts cleared. They asked for a follow-up: permanent allowlist or scheduled reservation during peak windows (daily 09:00-11:00 PST). I'll file a ticket.

lena (ENG-PLATFORM): I'll open INF-2217 to automate a routing rule: if tenant==hillcrest and request_batch_size>64 then force-split and prefer priority pool. Also adding a post-deploy check to detect mis-mapped batch_keys.

sam (SRE): I'll update the runbook with steps: 1) create ephemeral reservation, 2) set tenant concurrency cap, 3) enable batch-split, 4) observe p99 for 10 min. Also suggest adding tenant-specific alert at p99>2s.

maria (CS): Filing CS ticket with options (reserved capacity vs scheduled reservation vs increased customer-side batching hints). Thanks all :tada:
